notes.title: I'll be Brave, Tomorrow - Developer Playthrough - GIVING MONEY TO CHARITY?
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2741070/Ill_be_Brave_Tomorrow__Narrative_Platformer_for_Charity/
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831101/4991ebd7d314b5ba851f9d428bd8f85c03283fcc.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831101/ebe3e8533f1904faa929c1feb0389b255ba5f842.png

 An adventure driven narrative experience
 Precise pixel art platforming inspired by the 80's
 Fun replayable minigames
 A deep narrative revolving around a sick child
 50% of revenue goes to Great Ormond Street Hospital Charity
The game itself has two aspects; The 3D hospital room, where there are many objects to interactive with, as well as mini-games to keep the kid entertained...

But there is also the video game they play, which is a classic 2D retro platformer! The 3D world will interact with the 2D in various ways, from new mechanics found, to boss fights!

InkForge Studios are supporting the wonderful Great Ormond Street Hospital (GOSH) Charity, pledging to donate 50% of the games Steam revenue!
